item.title: BasiliskII Macintosh 68k Emulator Ported to ESP32-P4 / M5Stack Tab5
item.description:
📝 BasiliskII ESP32 — Classic Macintosh Emulator for M5Stack Tab5 A full port of the BasiliskII Macintosh 68k emulator to the ESP32-P4 microcontroller, running on the M5Stack Tab5 hardware. cpp Display driver with 2× scaling Disk disk. cpp Touch + USB HID handling Supported ROMs The emulator works best with Macintosh Quadra series ROMs: ROM File Machine Recommended Q650.

item.description:

item.description:
